audit_items.proof_trace: exchange_rate = (cash + debt - cash_reserve) / total_supply is non-decreasing under all operations: (1) accrue_interest adds interest_accumulated to debt but only reserve_factor * interest_accumulated (<= 1 by admin validation in asset_admin.move:81) to cash_reserve, so numerator grows by at least (1 - reserve_factor) * interest; (2) all int_mul/int_div truncation in mint, burn, and liquidation favors the pool, ensuring remainder stays in the reserve; (3) borrow/repay/take_revenue/flash loans produce zero net change to the numerator. No bad-debt write-down mechanism exists in the codebase.
